citationCorrection: the portrait rule lives in #196 Portrait & Photo Studio (not #195 — seasonal world events); #196's own anchor quotes #80's schema: consistency 'MUST REPRODUCE in every generation of this individual'
law: once an individual is kept (or its record exists in the Ranger's history), every rendering of THAT individual renders that individual: #322 variation rendered from the record's snapshot (never re-derived against a retuned table) + any #318 ruled deviation reproduced exactly — including ABSENCE-class deviations (the maskless Verdilance's record art shows no shield, at every surface, forever; 'completing' him is the error the register exists to prevent)
silhouetteLaw: silhouettes stay SPECIES-level (#197 lock axis, #207 presentation) — never an individual: an individual silhouette would leak the deviation before the meeting is earned; individual truth appears only at the tier that earned it
surfacesBound: Garden / follower presentation where the individual is the subject (#58 / #65)

tiers.kept: the individual page opens; the fidelity law binds in full from that moment
tiers.seen: species art + name (a species truth); a wild encounter renders the met individual by its variation, but the record page still shows the species

wildSide: a recognised individual met wild renders as itself (variation + deviation); an unrecognised one renders by its variation snapshot alone
